messages:
maria: Scheduling deploy v2.3.1 to prod tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Need smoke-check owners, rollback runbook verification, and DB-migration toggle owners. Quiet window 05:50-06:20. Who can take smoke checks and be on rollback duty?

jordan: I can own smoke checks + metrics. Will run perf smoke, basic flows, and hit /v1/health. @sam can you own rollback execution?

sam: I can. I have the rollback playbook link and will be on-call 06:00-07:00. Rollback CLI I'll use if needed:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/redwood-api --to-revision=<REVISION>
```
Plan: toggle traffic off -> undo if not improving.

ava: I'll validate model pools and KV cache warming. Will run `scripts/warm_cache.sh --models all` and watch p95.

maria: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-v2.3.1. Rollback criteria: error rate >2% sustained 5m, p95 latency +150ms vs baseline, or data-corruption alert => immediate rollback.

jordan: Canary: 5% for 5m -> 25% 10m -> 50% 10m -> 100% if green. Abort on alerts. I'll add synthetic monitor every 30s.

sam: DB migration escape hatch: feature flag `use_new_index` flip to off first. If no stabilization in 10m, proceed to undo. Runbook has exact verification steps.

ops-bot: Scheduled quiet window 2026-03-18 06:00-06:20 UTC. Reminder 15m prior.

maria: @ava can you confirm snapshot/backup recency?

ava: Snapshot completed 2026-03-17T20:12Z. Checksums OK. :white_check_mark:

jordan: I'll run a preflight 30m prior and post checklist: migration dry-run, canary smoke, metric baselines, alert thresholds.

sam: I'll standby to execute rollback and coordinate postmortem if needed. Ping me directly at go/no-go.

maria: Thanks everyone — unless objections I'll mark release doc ready and tag owners. :rocket:
